note: 2026-09-30 GITSYNC-REVIVE (session_014hPP8CTfoZ8y3kfDt5QsCC), PR #14534, revised after the manager's review: a generic state-based hold was REJECTED. what: ict-git-sync (scripts/deploy_pull_restart.sh) runs `systemctl restart` on every ict-*.service when main advances, which STARTS a deliberately stopped ict-trader-live. MEASURED: stop-bot-service #13194 stopped the trader 14:15:23Z; git-sync restarted it 14:16:59Z and 14:22:27Z, so the forced cancels #13203/#13204 at 14:39Z hit Error 326 (clientId 497 in use by the revived trader). stop_bot.sh guards only the liveness watchdog. git-sync also restarts ict-liveness-watchdog.service (the oneshot) while its timer is paused. Proposed Tier-2 fix: deploy_pull_restart.sh should `try-restart` (restart only if active) for ict-trader-live, or skip units whose last stop was an operator stop (stop_bot writes a marker; start_bot clears it).
